stem.en: Which change would most improve repeated body actions without adding any new tissues?

text.en: Keep the existing tissues together in organised parts.
Add more pieces of every tissue and leave them scattered.
Spread every tissue more evenly across the whole body.
Make every tissue larger but keep the same arrangement.

explanation.en:
**Why “Keep the existing tissues together in organised parts.” is right**

The lesson showed that reliable actions depend on organised relationships, not on having more tissue or spreading it out.

**Why the others are not**

- **“Add more pieces of every tissue and leave them scattered.”** — the trap for anyone who believes more parts solve the problem.
- **“Spread every tissue more evenly across the whole body.”** — the trap for anyone who believes mixing improves coordination.
- **“Make every tissue larger but keep the same arrangement.”** — the trap for anyone who believes size alone creates coordination.

hints.en: Which change affects the working relationships between tissues?
